answer.justification: The pathogen is Clostridioides difficile, a spore-forming gram-positive anaerobic rod. Alcohol and quaternary ammonium compounds do not kill spores. Chlorine-based (bleach) disinfectant is required for environmental sterilization to eliminate spores and prevent transmission to the next patient.
